title: Naturally Smoky Uruguayan Turkey Ham Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring turkey ham, with a smoky twist and a plant-based friendly approach, served in a traditional kazan cauldron. This dish is perfect for festive occasions and gatherings.
instructions: Heat the kazan cauldron over medium heat and add the diced turkey ham to cook until browned.
Add the smoked paprika, chopped onion, and minced garlic to the cauldron and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced red bell pepper to the cauldron and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the canned diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
